## Overview

Python is a general-purpose language. A program is a set of modules, and the interpreter runs each module from the top.

## A first program

```python run
print("Hello, world!")
```

```output
Hello, world!
```

## The language at a glance

Blocks use indentation. Each value is an object, and each variable is a name for an object.
